Preserve the established UI layout, all screen content, the three screen arrangement, bottom navigation Home/Products/Appointments, the exact FOUR-column Products grid, chat roles and button positions. All repeated icons should use the same restrained new palette.

Maintain the outer presentation board clean warm offwhite, with readable external labels Home, Products, Agent conversation. Render the complete three screens in crisp high resolution. No photographs or extra decorations, apart from existing profile avatars. Keep copy and product identities unchanged. This must visibly feel significantly softer and less saturated than reference 1 while preserving contrast for readability.
